dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth geometric narrowing from the maximum lateral width of the mid-body toward the anterior head and the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetrical inward deviations along the lateral margins at the neck-like constriction; otherwise smooth planar edges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with localized high-intensity specular highlights on the anterior melon and mid-dorsal ridge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Sparse dark punctate marks visible on the posterior-most portion of the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct transverse indentation at the anterior neck region and visible surface creases near the posterior peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible transverse linear dark mark is present on the dorsal surface of the posterior region.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark oval aperture situated on the anterior dorsal midline.
